query: SELECT TIME_FLOOR(__time, 'PT1H') AS bucket, cab_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(fare_amount) AS fare, AVG(trip_distance) AS dist, SUM(passenger_count) AS pax, MAX(total_amount) * 1e20 AS huge, MIN(fare_amount) / 1e7 AS tiny FROM trips WHERE __time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-20 06:00:00' AND __time < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-20 09:00:00' GROUP BY 1, 2
